title: cross-reviewer risks[] entries miss canonical fields (risk_category, summary, recommendation, evidence_refs); kernel agent_bridge_warning fires
raised_by: ARIA-V10.4 full endurance cycle 2 (cyc-20260520T125220Z-auto, real-Claude, post-F-018 fix)
resolved_by: ARIA-V10.4 Phase 3.H.7 (Tier-1 concrete schema example + SSoT alignment)

evidence.f018_validation: F-018 fix WORKED — cross_review outer envelope now accepted (status='submitted' canonical). agent_result_accepted at agent_invocations layer. Plan state advanced to CROSS_REVIEW_REQUESTED.

new_failure_layer.error_message: risk_category must be a non-empty string

structural_root_cause.indirection_failure: F-018 fix referenced the canonical SSoT (layer-2-aria-canonical-envelope.md) but did NOT inline the risks[] entry schema in the agent prompt. The SSoT's risk-entry sketch used pipe-separated example notation (e.g. 'HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW') which the model parsed as 'illustrative only — pick any close variant' and produced its own field names (description/applies_to).
structural_root_cause.lesson: For per-entry schemas inside a top-level container, SSoT indirection alone is insufficient. The agent prompt MUST inline a fully-filled concrete example with EXACTLY the kernel-required field names. Show > tell: a populated example with every field present prevents the model from improvising.
structural_root_cause.tier_1_anchor: Same drift class as F-018 (envelope shape) and Plan V8.1 Bug 4 (challenger plan_content shape) — at each level of nesting, kernel contract must be made concrete in the prompt or the LLM improvises.

tier_1_architectural_fix.scope: single risk-entry schema — agent prompt now carries an authoritative concrete example with all 7 required kernel fields filled in
files_changed: .claude/agents/aria-cross-reviewer.md (anchor 2 — risks[] entry schema now inlines a fully-filled concrete example + lists every required field with kernel validator file:line reference)
.claude/knowledge/layer-2-aria-canonical-envelope.md (risk-entry sketch cleaned: removed pipe-notation, populated concrete values, added validator file:line reference)
aria-kernel/tests/invariants/v10/test_phase_v10_4_phase_3_h_7_cross_review_risk_schema.py (Tier-3 invariant — 3 tests catch the drift class structurally)
tier_1_architectural_fix.tier_rationale: Tier-1 (make impossible): the agent prompt now shows an exact-shape risk entry with every kernel-required field populated. The model cannot omit a field that is visibly present in its own contract. Tier-3 (make detectable): the new invariant scans the cross-reviewer agent prompt for the 7 canonical risk field names + ensures the SSoT example uses concrete values (not pipe-notation that LLMs misread).

kernel_code_changes: NONE — kernel validators were already correct. Bug was entirely in agent prompt + knowledge SSoT contract drift.

expected_impact_on_endurance.before_fix: F-018 closure unlocked challenger + outer envelope acceptance, but every cycle now hit F-019 at the Phase 2 record_cross_review boundary → agent_bridge_warning + plan stalled at CROSS_REVIEW_REQUESTED → eventual cross_review_poll_timeout → convergence_blocked.
expected_impact_on_endurance.after_fix: next cross_review subprocess (hot-reload picks up F-019 fix) emits canonical risks[] entries → kernel accepts each entry through Phase 2 record_cross_review × 2 → CROSS_REVIEWED transition → verdict derivation → cross_review_recorded event ⭐ (V10.4 architectural closure).
